comment: Public, indexable routes. Single source for the generated sitemap and for the per-route HTML that gives each page its own canonical URL and link preview. Anything behind sign-in does not belong here. `key` is the extensionless S3 key deploy.yml uploads the HTML to, so it has to match the path. Consumed by scripts/build-route-html.mjs.
